about:
# Overrated Song Shuffler

This mod picks a random song from Newgrounds/GD servers (weighted by how many rated levels have used it). Enjoy!

## Credits

- [List of every rated level in Geometry Dash](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BBx9X8IYBtr7dA5cWu_smM2XBkLZzCXy7TjeEWRgag0/edit?gid=1119535654#gid=1119535654) by Remy, 75, SkorchXP, and more
- Erymanthus for converting my CSV file to a JSON file

*(by the way, this mod was revived from the old Geode v3 era)*
